title: Unbought AnyList Items Carryover
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anylist:grocery list_status=* items_unchecked=*
| where items_unchecked>0
| stats sum(items_unchecked) as total_unchecked, avg(shopping_minutes) as avg_trip_min by store_name
| sort - total_unchecked
description: Surfaces grocery lists that ended shopping trips with unchecked items still on the list.
value: Carryover items cause duplicate purchases or missing ingredients when the next recipe depends on them.
implementation: Export AnyList completion stats with `items_unchecked` per trip and review stores with chronic carryover.
visualization: Bar chart of unchecked items by store.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which stores you keep leaving with items still unchecked on the list.
